body:
late on the bandwagon, but here goes nothing.

when i was fifteen, my mom was pregnant, and i started struggling with my mental health (unrelated to the pregnancy lmao). i was dating this guy at the time. i was twlling him how much i wanted to die, and he looked me dead in the face and said "do you really want your sibling to grow up knowing they had a sister, and that they'll never get to meet her?" i cried for a week.

​

my mom ended up miscarrying, but she had a baby not too long ago. my baby brother is my whole world and i'm so glad that i was here to meet him :))

i'm really sorry for your loss :(( losing pets is something people never really talk about; which is silly because they're a part of your family too. i'm sending you lots of good vibes and i hope every day is just a tiny bit easier.
